title: ‘Drunk Karen’ Goes Full Racist at The Holiday Inn
description:
A woman was arrested after allegedly falsely accusing a man of assaulting her in a drunken escapade at a hotel in Barrow County, Georgia. Winder Police said Amy Baxter, 32, called 911 multiple times to report the assault but continually hung up when asked for information. Police tracked her down at a hotel that she had been allegedly given a courtesy ride to by officers earlier due to her level of intoxication. Staff told police she caused a scene in the lobby even pointing to a guest who had just arrived to check in to the hotel accusing him of being the attacker. But when police asked Amy to describe the suspect, she had difficulties keeping her story straight. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
